summary: A half disc whose circle touches the axis (a horn torus) revolved 270 degrees, plus a ring-torus control 1 mm further out.

cases.name: revolve_half_disc_horn_torus_270
cases.note: A half disc of radius 14 whose centre is 14 mm from the axis (its circle touches the axis: a horn torus) revolved 270 degrees. The profile is the half of the disc away from the axis (x from 14 to 28); the circle's other half, not in the profile, touches the axis at the origin. Area: torus face (arc length pi r at centroid distance 14 + 2r/pi) plus cylinder face (length 28 at 14 mm), each x 3 pi/2, plus two half-disc caps: 7211.92881465. Faces: 4 geometric faces (torus with major radius = minor radius, cylinder, 2 caps); a kernel may split at a seam. SolidCraft's STEP writer emitted a B-spline with a collapsed pole row and a non-deterministic file; the kernel-side check is volume, area and determinism of the revolve.

volume.formula: Pappus: area pi r^2 / 2 = 307.876080052, centroid 14 + 4r/(3 pi) = 19.941784542 from the axis, volume = area x distance x 3 pi/2 = 28932.1760989.

cases.name: revolve_half_disc_ring_torus_270
cases.note: Control for revolve_half_disc_horn_torus_270: the same half disc with its centre 15 mm from the axis (a ring torus). Area: torus face pi r (15 + 2r/pi) 3 pi/2, cylinder face 28 x 15 x 3 pi/2, two caps: 7551.13739852.
